scripts.clean: node -e "require('fs').rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true }); console.log('dist/ cleaned.');"
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n watch,serve,reload -c blue,green,yellow "npm run watch" "npm run serve" "browser-sync start --proxy localhost:5000 --port 5001 --files dist/**/* --no-open"
